indications: L-glutamine oral powder is indicated to reduce the acute complications of sickle cell disease in adult and pediatric patients 5 years of age and older.
contraindications: 5 grams to 15 grams orally, twice daily based on body weight. (2) Each dose of L-glutamine oral powder should be mixed in 8 oz. (240 mL) of cold or room temperature beverage or 4 oz. to 6 oz. of food before ingestion. (2)
warningsAndPrecautions:
L-glutamine oral powder is supplied in paper-foil-plastic laminate packets containing 5 grams of L-glutamine white crystalline powder.
                  
                     Carton of 60 Packets: NDC 90058-057-60
                  
                  Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F) away from direct sunlight.
name: L-glutamine
